query:
-- Update user role enum to include affiliate and instructor
ALTER TABLE users MODIFY COLUMN role ENUM('site_owner', 'site_admin', 'org_super_admin', 'org_admin', 'instructor', 'affiliate', 'member', 'user') DEFAULT 'member' NOT NULL;

-- Create org_user_roles table for org-level role assignments
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS org_user_roles (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  orgId INT NOT NULL,
  userId INT NOT NULL,
  role ENUM('org_super_admin', 'org_admin', 'instructor', 'affiliate', 'member') NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_org_user_role (orgId, userId),
  FOREIGN KEY (orgId) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (userId) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);
